Author the part `frame`: a rectangular relief frame that sits around that boss - 60 x 50 mm in plan, 20 mm tall, centred on the origin, with a rectangular opening through it that stands off the scanned boss by the project's `relief_mm` parameter on every side. Every interface number is already in `globals.py` - read them through `hc` instead of repeating them.

The opening must clear the scan by at least 1.5 mm and no scanned point may sit more than 4.0 mm from the frame: a frame that clears everything locates nothing. Measure both with `compare_to_scan(part="frame", scan="boss.stl", units="mm")` and read `distance.scan_to_part_min_mm` and `distance.scan_to_part_max_mm`. Do NOT offset or thicken the scan itself - a mesh has no exact surfaces and the harness refuses those operations on mesh-derived geometry. Author the frame, then measure the gap.

Build the part and export it as STEP when the geometry is right.
